user.title: Choose setup
user.description: Choose Easy for quick sun-position shading. Choose Advanced when you also need schedules, temperature stages, safety, Night, Pause or individual cover behavior.

data_description.house_name: Used to identify this Smart Shading installation.
data_description.setup_type: Easy needs only a room, facade and covers. Advanced guides you through every optional automation and protection function.

room_setup.title: Set up the first room
room_setup.description: Add the first facade sector, cover group and covers. The wizard then offers every setting available for this installation.

room_and_covers.name: Room and covers
room_and_covers.description: Choose the facade and all covers that should move together.

data_description.name: Shown as the room name in Home Assistant and on the dashboard card.
data_description.direction: The preset defines when the sun reaches this facade.
data_description.group_name: Optional label for the covers that move together in this room.
data_description.profile: Select the physical cover type so suitable positions are used.
data_description.cover_entities: Select at least one Home Assistant cover.

sun_control.name: Sun control
sun_control.description: Sun geometry always works. Add either Lux or an external on/off confirmation when available.

data_description.lux_sensor: Optional Lux/illuminance sensor. Smart Shading creates its own Sun Presence status from the selected thresholds.
data_description.sun_presence_entity: Use an existing on/off entity where on means direct sun. Leave empty when Lux or sun geometry should be used.
data_description.sun_preset: Controls lux thresholds and delays when a lux sensor is selected.
data_description.azimuth_start: Geometry values are needed only for a custom facade direction.
data_description.azimuth_end: Geometry values are needed only for a custom facade direction.
data_description.elevation_min: Geometry values are needed only for a custom facade direction.

optional_improvements.name: Optional improvements
optional_improvements.description: These inputs can refine control but are not required.

data_description.weather_entity: Allows unsuitable weather states to prevent normal shading.
data_description.easy_temperature_gate: Optionally require a minimum outdoor temperature. Missing data never blocks shading.
data_description.outdoor_temperature: Optional. Used first by the temperature gate; weather temperature is the fallback.
data_description.outdoor_minimum: Minimum outdoor temperature for simple control shading.

data.heat_during_pause: Allow Heat Protection during a pause

data_description.indoor_temperature: Enables room comfort and heat thresholds.
data_description.outdoor_temperature: Can block normal shading in cold conditions.
data_description.outdoor_minimum: Minimum outdoor temperature for normal shading.
data_description.safety_blockers: Wind, frost or other binary sensors; on means blocked.
data_description.schedule_profile: Choose when normal shading may run. Heat and safety rules remain independent.
data_description.default_pause_mode: Defines when a temporary room pause is released automatically.
data_description.heat_during_pause: Keeps Heat Protection available while normal shading is paused.
data_description.external_movement_detection: Pause only after confirmed numeric position or slat feedback.
data_description.evaluation_interval_minutes: Additional check interval; state changes remain immediate.

global_settings.title: General settings
global_settings.description: Choose house-wide behavior. Detailed technical values are grouped and normally keep their defaults.

data_description.sun_entity: Provides sun elevation and azimuth. The Home Assistant sun entity is recommended.
data_description.position_tolerance: No new position command is sent while feedback stays within this deviation.
data_description.tilt_tolerance: No new slat command is sent while feedback stays within this deviation.
data_description.unknown_feedback_policy: Controls whether automation may continue when a cover has no numeric position feedback.
data_description.evening_release_time: An active Heat Protection mode is released no later than this time.
data_description.sunset_offset_minutes: Negative values mean before sunset; positive values mean after sunset.
data_description.advanced_mode: Shows schedules, temperatures, safety, Night, Pause and detailed cover behavior.
data_description.weather_entity: Optional weather source used by the selected mode.
data_description.diagnostic_level: Off: errors only. Events: mode changes, commands, and blockers. Full: every evaluation with inputs and decision.
data_description.evaluation_interval_minutes: In addition to sensor changes, Smart Shading checks the logic at this interval. Default: 20 minutes.

add_room.title: Create room
add_room.description: Select only sensors that exist. **Temperature and lux are sufficient for a complete shading strategy.** Safety sensors such as wind or frost are optional and override normal movement.

data_description.name: Neutral example: Living area, Room A, or Office.
data_description.indoor_temperature: Controls Comfort, Solar, and Heat Protection. Without this sensor only sun-dependent logic operates.
data_description.outdoor_temperature: Can prevent normal shading in cold weather. Leave empty for the first test if unavailable.
data_description.safety_blockers: Multiple selection: wind, frost, rain, or maintenance sensors. Normally `on` means danger is active. Leave empty when none are available.

room_schedule.title: When should shading operate?
room_schedule.description: The schedule only defines when normal shading is generally permitted. Sun position, lux, and temperature then decide whether movement is actually required. **Safety always remains active.** Choosing “Custom schedule” opens a separate page after Continue.

data_description.schedule_profile: All year: always permitted. Summer season: May through September. Custom: months, weekdays, and optional fixed times.

room_schedule_custom.title: Define a custom schedule
room_schedule_custom.description: Choose months, weekdays, and the daily permission rule. Start and end times are requested on a **separate next page only** when “Fixed time window” is selected.

data_description.active_months: Normal solar shading may operate during these months.
data_description.active_weekdays: Select every weekday that should be active.
data_description.day_window: “Sun in sector” needs no fixed clock time and is the recommended default.
data_description.outside_schedule_behavior: Safety remains active regardless of this choice.
data_description.heat_outside_schedule: Recommended: enabled, so overheating can still be prevented outside the normal season.

sector_direction.title: Select facade direction
sector_direction.description: Select the direction of the window or cover group. Smart Shading applies a practical azimuth range and minimum solar elevation automatically. Custom geometry remains editable later under “Sector geometry”.

data_description.direction: Example: if the facade faces approximately south, choose “South (S)”.

sector_lux.title: Detect direct sunlight
sector_lux.description: A lux sensor is optional but recommended. With a lux sensor Smart Shading creates a delayed Sun Presence binary sensor for the sector.

data_description.lux_sensor: Optional Lux/illuminance sensor. Smart Shading creates its own Sun Presence status from the selected thresholds.
data_description.sun_preset: Balanced is the recommended starting point. Custom exposes all thresholds and delays.

sector_lux_custom.title: Custom Sun Presence
sector_lux_custom.description: ON and OFF use hysteresis to avoid movement during short cloud periods. **ON must be higher than OFF.**

data_description.sun_on_lux: The value must remain above this threshold for the complete ON delay.
data_description.sun_off_lux: The value must remain below this threshold for the complete OFF delay.
data_description.sun_on_delay: Prevents activation from brief bright peaks.
data_description.sun_off_delay: Prevents opening during brief cloud periods.

add_layer.title: Create cover group
add_layer.description: A layer groups covers that share the same physical strategy. Select a cover type and Smart Shading applies suitable defaults.

data_description.name: Neutral example: Window group, Cover group A, or South exterior blinds.
data_description.profile: Exterior venetian blinds lower fully for sun shading and then guide only their slats. Heat Protection closes the slats completely.

layer_tilt_profile.title: Select slat guidance
layer_tilt_profile.description: During active sun shading the exterior blind moves fully down. The profile controls only the slat position: “More glare protection” closes further, “Balanced” is the default, and “More daylight” opens further. 0% = fully open, 100% = fully closed. “Custom” opens the four editable stages next.

data_description.tilt_preset: Balanced is the recommended default. Custom exposes all four sun elevations and slat positions.

layer_tilt_custom.title: Customize adaptive slat guidance
layer_tilt_custom.description:
The four stages apply from their configured sun elevation. The blind itself remains fully down.

0% = fully open · 100% = fully closed

data_description.elevation_1: Typical in the morning or evening. Default: 10°.
data_description.tilt_1: Nearly closed for strong glare protection. Default: 90% closed.
data_description.elevation_4: Typical for high midday sun. Default: 60°.
data_description.tilt_4: Wide open for daylight. Default: 15% closed.

add_covers.title: Assign covers
add_covers.description: Select all covers for this group at once. The next step asks for a short display name and short code for each selected cover.

data_description.cover_entities: Multiple selection is supported. A cover can be assigned only once within a house.

after_room.title: Review setup
after_room.description: This room is ready. Add sectors, groups, covers or another room, review the room, or start Smart Shading.

menu_options.add_more_covers: Add more covers to this group
menu_options.add_another_layer: Add another cover group to this sector

init.title: Manage Smart Shading
init.description: Select a room to manage it. This overview contains only rooms and house-wide actions.

edit_room_basic.title: Room and sensors
edit_room_basic.description: Change only sensors that are actually available.

data.name: Room name
data.safety_blockers: Wind, frost, rain, or other safety sensors (optional)

data_description.safety_blockers: Multiple selection is supported. Select only binary sensors where `on` means danger. Leave this empty when no such sensors exist.
data_description.indoor_temperature_name: Optional label for the detailed dashboard card; raw entity IDs are never displayed.
data_description.outdoor_temperature_name: Optional label for the detailed dashboard card; raw entity IDs are never displayed.

edit_room_schedule_custom.title: Define a custom schedule
edit_room_schedule_custom.description: Choose months, weekdays, and the daily permission rule. Start and end times are requested on a **separate next page only** when “Fixed time window” is selected.

data_description.active_months: Normal solar shading may operate during these months.
data_description.active_weekdays: Select every weekday that should be active.
data_description.day_window: “Sun in sector” needs no fixed clock time and is the recommended default.

room_advanced.title: Temperatures and conditions
room_advanced.description: Visible temperature thresholds depend on the cover profiles used in the room. Rooms with exterior venetian blinds only have normal solar shading and heat protection.

data.heat_fail_safe: Keep active heat mode on sensor failure
data.heat_requires_sun: Require sun to start heat protection

data_description.normal_shading_temperature: From this room temperature, an exterior venetian blind lowers fully and guides its slats adaptively while the sector has sun.

edit_sector_customer.title: Direction and sunlight
edit_sector_customer.description: Changing the facade direction reapplies suitable default azimuth values. Custom lux values remain available separately.

edit_sector_lux_custom.title: Customize Sun Presence
edit_sector_lux_custom.description: ON must be higher than OFF.

edit_sector_advanced.title: Fine-tune the solar sector
edit_sector_advanced.description: This page is only needed for special cases and expert tuning. **0°/360° = north, 90° = east, 180° = south, 270° = west.** The range defines between which solar directions this window group is considered directly exposed. North-facing ranges may wrap across zero, for example 300° to 60°.

data_description.name: Shown in status sensors and the dashboard card, for example “South”.
data_description.short: Compact card label, for example S, SW, or E.
data_description.azimuth_start: First solar direction considered direct sun. Example for south: 120°.
data_description.azimuth_end: Last solar direction considered direct sun. Example for south: 240°.
data_description.elevation_min: 0° is the horizon and 90° is directly overhead. 10° ignores very low sun near the horizon; trees or neighboring buildings may justify a higher value.

edit_layer_customer.title: Cover group
edit_layer_customer.description: Changing the cover type reapplies suitable profile defaults while assigned covers remain unchanged.

edit_layer_tilt_profile.title: Slat profile
edit_layer_tilt_profile.description: KNX slat semantics: 0% means fully open, 100% means fully closed.

edit_layer_tilt_custom.title: Adaptive slat guidance
edit_layer_tilt_custom.description: The blind stays down; values control only the slat position (0% open, 100% closed).

edit_layer_advanced.title: Target positions
edit_layer_advanced.description: Only values relevant to the selected cover type are shown. Cover height: 0% closed, 100% open. Slat position: 0% fully open, 100% fully closed.

edit_cover.title: Configure individual cover
edit_cover.description: These values override only this cover. The shared movement strategy remains configured for the cover group.

data.name: Display name
data.window_returns_to_automation: Return to automation after the window closes

data_description.window_returns_to_automation: Enabled by default. Window-triggered movement while unsafe and the return movement after closing do not create a manual pause. Explicit cover and room pauses remain active.
data_description.max_open_position: Example: 90% when a cover must never open fully for safety reasons.
data_description.invert_position: Use only when the Home Assistant entity itself reports 0/100 in the wrong direction. KNX inversion normally belongs in the KNX cover configuration.
data_description.invert_tilt: The default is the KNX slat scale: 0% fully open and 100% fully closed. Enable this only when this cover exposes the opposite direction.
data_description.short: Short label used by the card.

room_schedule_time.title: Set the daily time window
room_schedule_time.description: These times are only used because “Fixed time window” was selected. Overnight windows are supported, for example 22:00 to 06:00.

data_description.start_time: Normal automation may operate from this time.
data_description.end_time: After this time, the selected outside-schedule behavior applies.

sector_geometry.title: Fine-tune the solar sector
sector_geometry.description: This page is only needed for special cases and expert tuning. **0°/360° = north, 90° = east, 180° = south, 270° = west.** The range defines between which solar directions this window group is considered directly exposed. North-facing ranges may wrap across zero, for example 300° to 60°.

data_description.name: Shown in status sensors and the dashboard card, for example “South”.
data_description.short: Compact card label, for example S, SW, or E.
data_description.azimuth_start: First solar direction considered direct sun. Example for south: 120°.
data_description.azimuth_end: Last solar direction considered direct sun. Example for south: 240°.
data_description.elevation_min: 0° is the horizon and 90° is directly overhead. 10° ignores very low sun near the horizon; trees or neighboring buildings may justify a higher value.

edit_room_schedule_time.title: Set the daily time window
edit_room_schedule_time.description: These times are only used because “Fixed time window” was selected. Overnight windows are supported, for example 22:00 to 06:00.

data_description.start_time: Normal automation may operate from this time.
data_description.end_time: After this time, the selected outside-schedule behavior applies.

room_pause_setup.title: Pause and manual override
room_pause_setup.description: By default, pressing Pause pauses until the next morning relative to sunrise. Safety always remains active. Heat protection may optionally continue during a pause.

data_description.default_pause_mode: Recommended: until next morning. “Until manually resumed” never ends automatically.
data_description.pause_sun_offset_minutes: 0 minutes means exactly at the sun event. Positive values extend the pause.
data_description.pause_duration_hours: Only used when a fixed-duration pause is started.
data_description.heat_during_pause: Safety always overrides a pause. This option only affects heat protection.

room_advanced_setup.title: Temperature logic
room_advanced_setup.description: The displayed values depend on the cover profile. Exterior venetian blinds only use normal adaptive shading and heat protection; redundant comfort/solar stages are hidden.

data_description.heat_release_temperature: Hysteresis to prevent heat mode from toggling repeatedly.
data_description.reopen_temperature: Below this value the covers may reopen.
data_description.normal_shading_temperature: From this room temperature normal solar shading may lower the cover fully and guide the slats adaptively.

edit_room_pause.title: Pause settings
edit_room_pause.description: By default, pressing Pause pauses until the next morning relative to sunrise. Safety always remains active. Heat protection may optionally continue during a pause.

data_description.default_pause_mode: Recommended: until next morning. “Until manually resumed” never ends automatically.
data_description.pause_sun_offset_minutes: 0 minutes means exactly at the sun event. Positive values extend the pause.
data_description.pause_duration_hours: Only used when a fixed-duration pause is started.
data_description.heat_during_pause: Safety always overrides a pause. This option only affects heat protection.

edit_room_night.title: Night Mode
edit_room_night.description: Positions this room from one night source. Transition windows avoid short open-close movements.

data_description.night_morning_transition_minutes: Hold the Night target while a geometrically relevant sector waits for its shading conditions. 0 disables the hold.
data_description.night_evening_transition_minutes: Hold the current target when Night starts shortly after evening release. 0 disables the hold.

edit_room_night_entity.title: Select Night source entity
edit_room_night_entity.description: Use a Home Assistant Schedule Helper for weekly planning. On means Night active; off means daytime evaluation.

edit_room_night_sun.title: Night relative to the sun
edit_room_night_sun.description: Set separate offsets for the Night start at sunset and Night end at sunrise.

room_pause_sun_setup.title: Pause relative to the sun
room_pause_sun_setup.description: Choose how many minutes before or after the selected sun event normal automation resumes. 0 minutes means exactly at sunrise or sunset.

data_description.pause_sun_offset_minutes: Negative values resume earlier; positive values resume later. Recommended next-morning default: 0 minutes.

room_pause_duration_setup.title: Fixed pause duration
room_pause_duration_setup.description: This duration is used when the pause mode is set to “For a fixed duration”.

data_description.pause_duration_hours: Normal automation resumes automatically when the duration ends.

sector_identity.title: Name the sun sector
sector_identity.description: The direction range is already preset. Give this sector a unique display name and short code. For multiple south sectors, names such as “South left” and “South right” are useful.

data_description.name: This name appears in status entities and the card.
data_description.short: Short code for chips and the sun track, e.g. S1.

name_selected_cover.title: Name cover {current} of {count}
name_selected_cover.description:
Selected entity: **{entity_name}**

compact_schedule_custom.title: Custom schedule

compact_sun_custom.title: Custom Sun Presence values
compact_sun_custom.description: These values are lux thresholds. ON must be higher than OFF.

compact_layer.title: Cover group and covers
compact_layer.description: Select the cover type and add multiple covers at once. Exterior venetian blinds automatically use fully lowered adaptive shading and fully closed heat protection.

compact_tilt_custom.title: Custom slat curve
compact_tilt_custom.description: The blind is fully lowered during shading. These values control only the slat position: 0% fully open, 100% fully closed.

data_description.night_enabled: Enable automatic Night positions for this room.
data_description.night_source: Choose an entity or automatic sunset/sunrise.

data_description.night_end_offset_minutes: Moves Night end before or after the selected source.

data_description.night_evening_transition_minutes: Allows a calm handover when Night begins.

initial_conditions_setup.title: Temperatures, Heat and safety
initial_conditions_setup.description: Review the remaining optional inputs and thresholds. Empty sensors are ignored.
